Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EName: P.Nikitha\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERoll no: 102\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E60 y old male \u0026nbsp;who is resident of suryapet ,farmer by occupation \u0026nbsp;came to opd with\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Echief complaints :-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPedal edema since 3 months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShortness of breath Since 20 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDecreased urine output since 15 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWeakness of lower limbs since 4 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of presenting illness:-\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 3 months back when he noticed \u0026nbsp;bilateral pedal edema initially extending to ankle Gradually progressed up to thighs which worsened during last 15 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-Decreased urine output since 15 days, not associated with frequency, urgency burning micturation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-Grade 3 shortness of breath, no aggravating and relieving factors.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-fever since 15 days intermittent associated with chills and rigors\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESeries of events :-\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of trauma by fall from tree 25 years back\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor which he used NSAIDS for 4\/5 yrs ..\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eand then 7 years back when patient was undergoing hydrocele surgery he was diagnosed with ckd accidentally . For which he got treated by dailysis initially and then he started using medications and was apparently well till 3 months back\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3 months back patient developed bilateral pedal edema, facial puffiness \u0026nbsp;for the first time and shortness of breath so he visited local hospital and they referred to our hospital for dailysis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince then patient was coming here regularly twice a weak for dialysis .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter his last dialysis session he went back home and he developed discomfort in chest and weakness of limbs . Patient also had few episodes of altered sensorium in between which was associated with fever and chills .So he was brought to hospital again.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #800180; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPast history :\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is known case of hypertension since 6 months and was on medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case of asthma , diabetes mellitus,epilepsy,tuberculosis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is history of blood transfusions .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr
